facts.fact: Ministerial order no. 038974 of 6 November 2025 authorised Starlink Sénégal SUARL to operate as an internet access provider for five years, renewable.
Starlink Sénégal SUARL launched its service commercially in February 2026.

The Supreme Court ordered on 7 September 2026 the provisional suspension of Starlink Sénégal SUARL's authorisation for fixed satellite internet access, on a challenge by Sonatel; the ruling does not settle the merits.
